## What changed

Describe the user-facing or engineering change.

## Quality checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior
- [ ] Authentication/session/BFF impact reviewed
- [ ] Input/output schemas and error states reviewed
- [ ] Keyboard/accessibility behavior reviewed
- [ ] Responsive behavior reviewed
- [ ] No client-visible secret or sensitive server value was introduced
- [ ] Screenshot or short evidence attached for meaningful visual changes

## Deployment

Document environment/configuration changes and rollback considerations when applicable.
